description: This file is an integration test class for the Offices API in the Fineract project. It contains tests that create a new office and retrieve existing office details to verify API functionality.

classes.name: OfficeTest
classes.description: Integration test class for the /offices API, extending the base IntegrationTest class providing test methods for creating and retrieving offices.

methods.name: createOne
methods.description: Test method that creates a new office with a unique name and validates the creation based on a positive office ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneExistingInclDateFormat
methods.description: Test method that retrieves the list of offices and checks that at least one exists with a non-null opening date.
